overview.name: MicroSectors™ -3× Short Semiconductor ETNs
overview.description: The index is a total return index that tracks the performance of the VanEck® Semiconductor ETF (the “Reference Fund”). The index is designed to provide exposure to the performance of 25 of the largest and most liquid U.S. exchange-listed companies in the semiconductor industry through a single fund-tracking vehicle.
